intention: 当你收到他们的消息时
pattern: Let me know when you hear from them.
sentencePatterns: Let me know when you hear from them.
Please update me when you hear from the team.

usageNotes: hear from sb. = 收到某人的联系（消息/邮件/电话）。区分 hear from sb. vs hear about sth.。
